source: You have no %s talent points left!

deep_observation: 漏译数量限定并弱化为可选：源文「For each talent put on cooldown, you reduce the cooldown of one of your talents currently on cooldown by %d turns」是每计入一次、只对己方一个仍在冷却的技能减 %d 回合；译文「每使一个技能进入冷却，你可以减少你处于冷却中的技能的冷却时间 %d 回合」无「一个」限定，读作把自己所有冷却中技能一并缩减，且「你可以」暗示玩家可选，实际为自动随机取。证据（第七节）：组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/talents/chronomancy/energy.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63；关键调用 action 第110-123行 if count>=1 then ... for i=1,count do local tid=rng.tableRemove(tids); self:alterTalentCoolingdown(tid, -cdr) end（每轮只取出并缩减一个不重复技能），info 第132-137行 tformat(talentcount, cooldown, cooldown)。
source:

surface_observation: 原文“one of your talents currently on cooldown”明确每次只缩减自身一个技能的冷却；译文漏掉“一个”的数量限制，可被理解为缩减自身所有冷却中技能的冷却。

source:
Welcome #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#.
You are a citizen of the Sunwall, and like many of your age you have been trained in combat and magic. It can be a harsh life, and though you dream at times of venturing to distant lands you know your duty is to help defend the outpost against the vicious onslaught from the Orc Prides. But now High Sun Paladin Aeryn has advised you of a new threat.

Nagas have been sighted in the Slazish Fens on the other side of the Sunwall Mountains. Their objective is unclear, but an assault from both sides would be truly devastating at such a pivotal time for your people. Though there are few forces to spare on the front line against the Prides, you have volunteered to investigate the naga threat and stop them if need be.

By the power of the Sun and the blessings of the Moons you step forth to find your fate.

deep_observation: 机制反转：源文「You walk three different timelines, choosing the one you prefer at the end」是先依次走完三条时间线、最后择一保留；译文「你可以从三条时间线中选择一条进入」变成事前挑一条进入，丢掉 at the end，并使同句「当前时间线：%d」（eff.thread 依次为 1、2、3）失去依据。证据（第七节）：组件 tome，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63；game/modules/tome/data/timed_effects/other.lua 第624-685行——activate 置 eff.thread=1 并 chronoClone("see_threads_base")，deactivate 在 eff.thread<3 时 chronoRestore("see_threads_base") 回到起点、eff.thread+1 重走，仅当 thread 达 3 才 Chat.new("chronomancy-see-threads") ；game/modules/tome/data/chats/chronomancy-see-threads.lua 的 select(id) 用 chronoRestore("see_threads_"..id) 在结束时择一。
source: You walk three different timelines, choosing the one you prefer at the end (current timeline: %d).
surface_observation: 原文“walk three different timelines, choosing the one you prefer at the end”表示经历三条不同时间线后在最后选择偏好的一条；译文“从三条时间线中选择一条进入”改成先选一条再进入，改变了选择与经历的先后关系。
